title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: How to set Company Badge (System Indicator) via AL Code – Automatically set Company Badge
summary: This post explains how to set company badges (system indicators) automatically via AL code using the UI Helper Triggers codeunit event subscriber, without modifying the Company Information table. Company badges help users identify which company and environment they are working in.
key_points: Use codeunit 2000000004 'UI Helper Triggers' and subscribe to the GetSystemIndicator business event to set company badges programmatically
Set badge text and style using the Style Option, which includes 10 predefined color options from Standard to Bright Purple
Apply different badges based on company name or other logic using case statements in the event handler
Round badges indicate production environments while square badges indicate sandbox environments
Browser refresh (Ctrl+F5) updates the badge display in the client
features: System Indicator styling with color options
